name: Sharp Chucks and Machines Ltd

business_overview: Sharp Chucks and Machines Ltd (Jalandhar-based, incorporated 1994) manufactures lathe and power chucks, drill chucks, back plates, castings and forgings and other machine-tool accessories/spares, sold domestically and via exports. It is a small, generic capital-goods component supplier rather than a differentiated or thematic business.
